summary: Your feedback has helped improve the new pull request Overview page since its November 5, 2026 public preview. Clearer merge status and next steps Failed optional checks no longer make mergeable pull requests appear blocked.
takeaways: Comments mentioning Copilot now better explain the action and selected model before submission.
Previously missing merge requirements now show what needs attention.
Fixed uneven spacing, misalignment, and sidebar gaps across screen sizes.
